cell_type_or_model: adult demyelinating spinal-cord lesions; mature spinal-cord astrocytes
assay_or_perturbation: BMP4/BMP7 exposure; noggin inhibition; pSMAD1/5/8, nuclear SMAD1 and CSPG assays
evidence_summary: BMP4 and BMP7 increased around spinal demyelinating lesions; astrocytes showed pSMAD1/5/8 and nuclear SMAD1, and BMP4 increased aggrecan/neurocan CSPGs in a noggin-sensitive manner.
limitations: Demyelinating rather than contusive SCI; BMPR paralog and exact ligand-specific receptor complex were not resolved.

cell_type_or_model: BMP-responsive Id1 promoter and Smad binding assays
assay_or_perturbation: BMP versus TGF-beta stimulation; promoter deletion/motif analysis; Smad-dependent transcription assays
evidence_summary: Id1 was identified as a direct BMP target with Smad-dependent promoter elements; BMP, but not TGF-beta, strongly activated the Id1 promoter.
limitations: Comparator promoter systems; does not establish a particular BMPR paralog or SCI receiver-cell relevance.

species: human promoter and C2C12 myoblast comparator
cell_type_or_model: BMP2 stimulation; constitutively active or dominant-negative BMPR-IA/BMPR-IB; Smad4-deficient cells; Id1 reporter and mRNA assays
evidence_confidence: BMP2 activated Id1 through BMPR-IA/BMPR-IB and a Smad1/Smad4 complex at a BMP-responsive promoter element; dominant-negative receptors or Smad7 blocked the response.
evidence_summary: The exact type-II receptor context and SCI applicability are unresolved.

cell_type_or_model: primary astrocytes and cortical injury model
assay_or_perturbation: fibrinogen exposure; TGFBR1 inhibitor; fibrinogen depletion; Smad2 phosphorylation, neurocan and neurite-outgrowth assays
evidence_summary: Fibrinogen-associated active TGF-beta induced Smad2 phosphorylation and neurocan deposition; genetic or pharmacologic depletion reduced the pathway and glial-scar outputs.
limitations: Cortical injury rather than SCI; fibrinogen is the initiating extracellular context and direct TGFB1 occupancy is not the only causal step.
